brief.topic: Local-first DOM element addressing and collaboration annotation for a developer workbench

criteria.question: Does the repository natively provide an embeddable way for a human to visually select or highlight a live DOM/UI element?
Does the repository provide or compose with stable semantic element references rather than only screenshot coordinates, CSS selectors, or a developer-only DOM tree?
Can the relevant capability run locally and be embedded/adapted without requiring a hosted feedback or telemetry service?
Can the capability preserve a human feedback artifact or context suitable for a copyable/deep-linkable review reference without capturing secrets by default?
What license, release/version evidence, dependency surface and exit constraints does the repository declare for this capability?
